accepted.s: The Indian Cyber Crime Coordination Centre (I4C) was approved in which year?
accepted.x: I4C was approved in 2018 under the Ministry of Home Affairs.
accepted.tq: Use the direct year-recall method for an institutional milestone.
accepted.sec: I4C - parent ministry, components, National Cyber Security Coordinator

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding the Indian Cyber Crime Coordination Centre (I4C):
1. It was approved under the Ministry of Home Affairs.
2. It became fully operational in 2020.
3. It is a statutory body created by an Act of Parliament.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: I4C was approved under the Ministry of Home Affairs and became fully operational in 2020. It is an executive framework, not a statutory body.
accepted.tq: Identify the wrong institutional-status statement before choosing the coded option.
accepted.sec: I4C - parent ministry, components, National Cyber Security Coordinator

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly describes the institutional status of I4C?
o: An executive framework, not a statutory body
A judicial body under the Supreme Court
A constitutional authority under the Ministry of Home Affairs
accepted.x: I4C is an executive framework and is not a statutory body.
accepted.tq: Test the distinction between statutory and executive institutions.
accepted.sec: I4C - parent ministry, components, National Cyber Security Coordinator

accepted.s: I4C was upgraded to an Attached Office in which year?
accepted.x: I4C was upgraded to an Attached Office in 2024.
accepted.tq: Discriminate between the years of operationalisation and institutional upgrading.

accepted.s: Which I4C component is intended for reporting all cyber crimes, particularly crimes against women and children?

accepted.s: The helpline number 1930 is primarily associated with:

Reporting cyber crimes against children only
Reporting financial fraud and initiating rapid freezing of funds
accepted.x: The 1930 helpline is used to report financial fraud, particularly for action during the ‘golden hour’ to freeze funds.

accepted.s:
Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?

a. CFCFRMS — Real-time freezing of defrauded funds
b. NCAP — Takedown notices to intermediaries
c. SAHYOG — AI and Big Data crime analytics
d. Samanvaya — Online training of judges
accepted.x: CFCFRMS facilitates real-time freezing of defrauded funds. NCAP undertakes AI and Big Data crime analytics, SAHYOG issues takedown notices, and CyTrain provides online training to police, prosecutors and judges.
accepted.tq: Start from the sure component-role pair and reject swapped functions.
accepted.sec: I4C - parent ministry, components, National Cyber Security Coordinator

Issuing digital certificates to government departments
Inter-state cybercrime data sharing and joint investigation support
accepted.x: Samanvaya supports inter-state cybercrime data sharing and joint investigation.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the inter-state coordination platform from financial-fraud tools.
accepted.sec: I4C - parent ministry, components, National Cyber Security Coordinator

accepted.s: SAHYOG is associated with which function?
o: Freezing defrauded funds in real time
Reporting crimes against women and children

accepted.s:
Which one of the following is correctly matched?

a. CyTrain — Online training for police, prosecutors and judges
b. Cybercrime Forensic Lab Consortium — Financial-fraud helpline
c. CFCFRMS — Cybercrime data-sharing platform
 d. National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal — Takedown notices to intermediaries
accepted.x: CyTrain provides online training for police, prosecutors and judges. The other functions are associated respectively with the Cybercrime Forensic Lab Consortium, CFCFRMS, Samanvaya and SAHYOG.

accepted.s: Which of the following statements is correct regarding Cyber Commandos?
o: They are private ethical-hacking teams appointed by banks.
They are specially trained police cyber units under I4C.
They are military units under the Ministry of Defence only.
They are judicial officers attached to cyber courts.
accepted.x: Cyber Commandos are specially trained police cyber units functioning under I4C.
accepted.tq: Reject the authority-swapping trap in an institutional description.

accepted.s: Under the CFCFRMS Standard Operating Procedure of January 2026, banks may refund frauds below which amount without a court order?
accepted.x: The January 2026 CFCFRMS SOP permits banks to refund frauds below ₹50,000 without a court order.

accepted.s:
Which of the following correctly reflects the August 2026 status of selected cybercrime initiatives?
1. The Money Restoration Portal involved 57 banks.
2. The portal covered 36,290 cases and ₹18.05 crore.
3. e-Zero FIR was functional in 19 States.
4. All States had notified Cyber Crime Coordination Centres.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: The Money Restoration Portal involved 57 banks, 36,290 cases and ₹18.05 crore, while e-Zero FIR was functional in 19 States. Only 14 States had notified Cyber Crime Coordination Centres, so statement 4 is false.
accepted.tq: Spot the absolute statement that reverses a stated partial-coverage figure.

accepted.s:
The National Cyber Security Policy, 2013 aimed at which of the following?
1. Securing and developing resilient cyberspace
2. Creating a trained cyber security workforce
3. Promoting research and development and indigenous security technology
4. Establishing an Information Security Assurance Framework
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: The policy aimed at resilient cyberspace, trained manpower, research and development, indigenous security technology and an Information Security Assurance Framework.
accepted.tq: Use the all-inclusive option after checking each policy objective separately.

accepted.s: The manpower target under the National Cyber Security Policy, 2013 was to create how many cyber security professionals in five years?
accepted.x: The target was to develop 5 lakh cyber security professionals within five years.
accepted.tq: Test the exact policy target rather than the broader objective.
accepted.sec: National Cyber Security Policy 2013 - objectives, manpower target, draft strategy  [GROUP-II]

o: A draft National Cyber Security Strategy

accepted.s: In Shreya Singhal v. Union of India, the Supreme Court struck down Section 66A of the Information Technology Act primarily for violating:
accepted.x: The Supreme Court struck down Section 66A for violating freedom of speech and expression under Article 19(1)(a), and held that it was not saved by Article 19(2).
accepted.tq: Match the judicial decision with the constitutional provision directly involved.
accepted.sec: Cases - Shreya Singhal (Section 66A)  [GROUP-II]

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding the decision in Shreya Singhal v. Union of India:
1. Section 66A was struck down.
2. Section 79 was read down.
3. Section 69A was upheld.
4. Section 66A was held to be saved by Article 19(2).
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: The Court struck down Section 66A, read down Section 79 and upheld Section 69A. Section 66A was not saved by Article 19(2), making statement 4 false.
accepted.tq: Separate the provisions struck down, read down and upheld; reject the reversed constitutional conclusion.
accepted.sec: Cases - Shreya Singhal (Section 66A)  [GROUP-II]
